Overview.title: Overview
Overview.subtitle: Project {project}
Overview.connectText: Adelie collects analytics from your social accounts every day. Pinterest comes first — Instagram and TikTok are next.
Overview.reauthBanner: {count, plural, one {# account needs} other {# accounts need}} to be reconnected
Overview.deltaHint: Change vs the previous period of the same length
Overview.preliminaryHint: Includes recent days that the platform is still finalizing — the number may change slightly.

chart.hint: Dashed: days the platform is still finalizing. Gaps: days without data — not zero.

interactions.title: Interactions
interactions.hint: Likes, saves, comments and shares of the account's content in the period.

MetricHints.impressions: How many times the Pin appeared on screen — in the feed, search or on boards. One person can count several times.
MetricHints.saves: How many times the post was saved — to a board on Pinterest, or to saved items on Instagram.
MetricHints.pinClicks: How many times the Pin was opened or clicked — on or off Pinterest, including clicks to your site.
MetricHints.outboundClicks: How many times people went from the Pin to your website or shop via its link.
MetricHints.followers: Followers of the account right now — not for the period. Changes are tracked since Adelie started collecting.
MetricHints.views: How many times the account's content was played or displayed — posts, Reels, stories. An Instagram metric, not the same as Pinterest impressions.
MetricHints.engagements: All interactions with the content: likes, comments, saves, shares, replies.
MetricHints.newFollowers: How many people followed in the period. Instagram gives this only for the last 30 days.
MetricHints.reach: How many different accounts saw the post at least once.
MetricHints.shares: How many times the post was shared.
MetricHints.videoViews: How many times the pin’s video was viewed. Lifetime only: Pinterest does not report it per day.
MetricHints.orders: Number of shop orders in the period.
MetricHints.revenue: What buyers paid, without the sales tax Etsy remits itself. Etsy fees are not subtracted.

Accounts.title: Connections
Accounts.subtitle: Platforms Adelie gets the project’s data from — for promotion and sales
Accounts.collectingHint: Adelie collects data daily from the moment of connection; the platform also returns up to 90 days of history.
Accounts.noPermission: Only the owner, an admin or a manager can connect accounts.

Accounts.anotherAccountHint: A platform connects the account you are signed in to in this browser. To add another one, switch to it on the platform's site first. An invitation link lets the account owner connect it themselves — no passwords shared.

sync.personal: Personal account: boards and pins are not available.
sync.personalHint: Pinterest shares pins and boards only of business accounts with apps. Switching to a free business account in Pinterest settings unlocks them; profile and account analytics already work.
sync.partial: Part of the data was not available during the last sync.
sync.failed: The last sync failed. Adelie will retry within an hour.
sync.partialHint: Some steps were skipped because the platform did not allow them; everything else is up to date. Adelie tries again with the next sync.
sync.failedHint: Adelie could not reach the platform. It will retry automatically within an hour; nothing needs to be done.

Accounts.emptyText: Connect a social network with the button in the top right — Adelie starts collecting its data right away. Shops are coming soon: Etsy, Shopify, your website.
Accounts.inviteCopied: Invitation link copied — valid for 7 days, single use.
Accounts.invitationsHint: Send the link to whoever owns the account — a client, or yourself in another browser. They connect it without an Adelie account; the link works once and expires in 7 days.
Accounts.actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {name}?
disconnectDialog.text: Adelie deletes the access tokens right away and stops syncing. The data collected so far stays — connect the same account again later and its history continues without a gap.
disconnectDialog.platformHint: To also remove Adelie from the account's connected apps, do it in Pinterest: Settings → Connected apps.

removeDialog.title: Delete {name} with all data?
removeDialog.text: The account, its pins, boards, metrics and sync history are deleted permanently. History older than 90 days cannot be fetched from the platform again.

accessDialog.title: Connect {platform}
accessDialog.lead: What Adelie may do with this account.

read.title: Read-only
read.etsy: Shop, products and orders — for analytics. Adelie changes nothing.

write.title: Full access
write.etsy: Everything in read-only, plus editing and creating products — only when you do it in Adelie yourself. Adelie cannot delete products or change orders or shop settings.

accessDialog.changeLater: You can change access any time from the connection’s “⋯” menu — the platform asks for consent again.

Invite.title: Connect {platform} to Adelie
Invite.lead: {name} from {workspace} invites you to connect your account so they can see its analytics.
Invite.leadNoName: {workspace} invites you to connect your account so they can see its analytics.

explain.pinterest: You will sign in on Pinterest and confirm access there. Adelie can only read profile, boards, pins and their statistics — it cannot post, edit or delete anything. Access can be revoked at any time in your Pinterest settings.
explain.instagram: You will sign in with Meta (Facebook / Instagram) and choose your professional Instagram account. Adelie can only read the profile, posts and their statistics — it cannot post, edit, delete or read messages. Access can be revoked at any time in your Instagram or Facebook settings.
explain.etsy: You will sign in to Etsy and confirm access there. Adelie can only read your shop, products and orders (amounts, items, country) — not buyers’ names, addresses or emails. It cannot change, publish or delete anything. You can revoke access any time in your Etsy settings.
explain.etsyWrite: You will sign in to Etsy and confirm access there. Adelie can read your shop, products and orders (not buyers’ names, addresses or emails) and edit or create products — only when a project member does it in Adelie. It cannot delete products or change orders or shop settings. You can revoke access any time in your Etsy settings.

Content.count: {kind, select, pin {{count, plural, one {# pin} other {# pins}}} other {{count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}}}
Content.lifetimeHint: Pin metrics are lifetime totals reported by Pinterest, updated daily. Pins saved from other accounts have no metrics — Pinterest reports them only to the pin's owner. “—” means no data, not zero.
Content.untitled: {kind, select, pin {Untitled pin} other {Post without a caption}}
Content.emptyText: Posts appear here after the first sync of a connected account. Personal Pinterest accounts don't share pins with apps.
Content.selected: {kind, select, pin {{count, plural, one {# pin selected} other {# pins selected}}} other {{count, plural, one {# post selected} other {# posts selected}}}}
Content.noMatches: {kind, select, pin {No pins match these filters.} other {No posts match these filters.}}
Content.periodHint: Daily pin metrics summed over the period. Pinterest gives pin history 90 days back; older days build up from the moment the account was connected. “—” means no data, not zero. Pins saved from other accounts have no metrics.
Content.lifetimeHintInstagram: Instagram post statistics are lifetime totals as reported by Meta, updated daily. “—” means no data, not zero.
Content.lifetimeOnly: Pinterest does not report this metric per day — it shows “—” for a period.
Content.csvAllHint: Unchecked, the CSV has the columns shown, in their order; checked, every metric of the platform.

columns.label: Columns
columns.title: Table columns
columns.hint: Your columns and their order are saved for you — the same on every device and in every project, separately for each platform. Drag a handle or use ↑/↓ to reorder.

Content.periodHintInstagram: Instagram does not report post statistics per day, so Adelie records the totals daily and takes the change from the previous day. Days accumulate from when Adelie started doing so (no history before that); a day ends at the daily sync. Reach for a period is how many new accounts saw the post. “—” means no data, not zero.

Post.metricsHint: Totals the platform reported as of {date}. “—” means no data, not zero.
Post.metricsHintNoDate: Totals the platform reported. “—” means no data, not zero.
Post.noMetrics: The platform reported no statistics for this post.
Post.instagramNoDaily: Instagram does not report post statistics per day — Adelie derives them from daily totals; this post has no days yet.
Post.dailyHint: Daily values from {from} to {to}. Dashed: days the platform is still finalizing.

hints.follows: How many people followed the account from this pin.

hints.views: How many times the post was played or displayed.

hints.engagements: Likes, comments, saves and shares together.

Sales.noShopsText: Connect a shop — Etsy, later Shopify and your website — and its products and orders show up here.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: What you sell — across the project’s shops
products.hint: Sold and revenue come from orders in the chosen period. Views and favorites are lifetime, as Etsy reports them. Price is the current one. “Removed” — products no longer in the shop that appear in orders.

hints.views: How many times the product page was viewed on Etsy — lifetime.
hints.favorers: How many people favorited the product on Etsy — lifetime.
hints.sold: Units sold in the chosen period.
hints.revenue: Earned for the units sold in the period — price × quantity, without tax and shipping.

hints.orders: Number of orders in the period.

money.title: What stays with the shop
money.hint: From the Etsy payment ledger for the period: sales without tax, minus refunds, Etsy fees and Etsy ads. Payouts to the bank are money moving, not costs, so they are not shown.
money.none: No money movements in this period.
money.salesHint: What buyers paid, without the sales tax Etsy remits itself.
money.feesHint: What Etsy charges for its services: transaction fees, payment processing, listing and renewal fees, and VAT on them.
money.adsHint: Etsy Ads (promotion in Etsy search) and Offsite Ads.
